_help: Answer only what you know. Leave "unknown" (or null) wherever you are not sure: unknown answers are ignored, never guessed. No free text: each value is one of the listed choices, a whole number, a date YYYY-MM-DD, or true / false. Entities are "enterprise", "org:<organization login>" or "cc:<cost center name>". Keys starting with _help are ignored.
_help_plan: Per entity: the plan the Licensing page shows: business, enterprise, mixed (both), or unknown.
_help_pool_seats: Per entity: how many Business and how many Enterprise seats (whole numbers), or unknown.
_help_billing_mode: Per entity: metered (monthly usage-based bill), volume (volume or enterprise agreement), azure (billed through an Azure subscription), or unknown.
_help_renewal_date: Per entity: the next subscription renewal date YYYY-MM-DD (volume and Azure contracts), or unknown.
_help_capped_policy: Per cost center with an AI-credit cap (key "cc:<name>"): block or continue when the cap is reached, or unknown. Example: {"cc:Platform": "block"}.
_help_compliance: Compliance program of the enterprise: none, data_residency, fedramp, or unknown.
_help_promo_eligible: true if your seats received the promotional included-credit allowance, false if not, or unknown.
_help_paid_usage_policy: Policy for paid usage beyond the included credits: enabled, disabled, or unknown.
_help_org_cli_billing_policy: Whether Copilot CLI usage billed to the organization is enabled, disabled, or unknown.
_help_budget_stop: Per budget scope (an entity): true if the budget stops usage when it is reached, false if it only alerts, or unknown.
_help_seat_policy: Per organization (key "org:<login>"): assign_all or assign_selected as shown in the organization's Copilot access settings, or unknown. Example: {"org:example": "assign_selected"}.
